Navigation

Прямой вход

A holding entry method where the aircraft flies directly onto the inbound leg of the holding pattern upon crossing the fix.

Questions and answers

What is Прямой вход?

In this glossary, Прямой вход refers to: A holding entry method where the aircraft flies directly onto the inbound leg of the holding pattern upon crossing the fix.

How is Прямой вход used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Выполните прямой вход в зону ожидания на точке ZEMEL и доложите, когда установились."
